services.desc: South End Adventures offers a variety of ocean fishing trips both nearshore and offshore. All fishing charter trips can accommodate a maximum of 6 guests. At the end of your adventure, we offer complimentary cleaning and filleting services for the fish kept. Make it memorable and choose the adventure that is right for you!
